messages.text:
The Westminster 16-inch French Edition is actually a floor globe — it's sold out right now, though. For a French-language floor globe, our top pick is the Replogle Obelisk 16" Raised Relief Floor Globe (Frank L. Wright Edition, French) — a striking antique relief map you can feel with your fingertips, from the Frank L. Wright collection, and it's in stock.

You'll find it under that exact name in the search bar, ready to add to your cart.
